title: GTA 6 Lets You Flip Your Car Back Over (It Never Tells You) 🚗 #Shorts
description:
Flipped your getaway car in GTA 6? You can push it back onto its wheels. Walk up to the side, click the left stick, then hold Square (PS5) or X (Xbox). It fails if the car is too heavy, you run out of stamina, or you're on a steep incline. Useful in police chases, when the Scooter Bros app can't repair your car. The same push moves a jet ski or boat off the sand into the water, and holding Circle/B lets you sit or lean almost anywhere. Kotaku's writer found both features by accident and, after 140+ hours, doesn't remember the game explaining them.

Source: Kotaku, "Two Cool, Hidden Features GTA 6 Doesn't Explain: Flipping And Sitting" (Nov 19, 2026).
Images: official Rockstar Games footage (An Extended Look, Trailer 2).
